steps.label: Start small
steps.sub: X-Small/Small, move up only with proof

caption: Query History, sorted by Duration or Bytes Scanned, surfaces what's worth tuning.

code:
SELECT query_id, user_name, warehouse_name,
       total_elapsed_time, bytes_scanned
FROM SNOWFLAKE.ACCOUNT_USAGE.QUERY_HISTORY
WHERE start_time >= DATEADD(day, -7, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
ORDER BY total_elapsed_time DESC
LIMIT 20;
caption: Account-wide, ordered by elapsed time — the most expensive queries first.
